text:
Nina (growth): quick idea  combine the 'starter prompts' credit experiment with the next webinar. people who register + run a qualifying request get an extra one-off 50 credit top-up if they complete the 3-template walkthrough within 48h of the webinar. helps with webinar->trial conversion and gives a benchmark story for the launch post.
Owen (demand-gen): neat. we can promote the webinar as "From Prompt to Prod in 48h" and lead gen via blog + paid channels. targeting PLG engineers + product folks. can we gate some credits to webinar-attended only?
Nina (growth): yes — two cohorts: A = inbound eligible (no webinar) gets base 75 credits for completing template flow; B = webinar registrants who attend get 75 + 50 bonus after walkthrough. compare lift.
Priya (analytics): metrics: primary = webinar registrant->active trial (>=1000 tokens in 7 days). secondary: trial->paid 14d, d7 retention, avg tokens/day. events to instrument: `webinar.registered`, `webinar.attended`, `template_walkthrough.started`, `template_walkthrough.completed`, `credits.granted`. we'll need `campaign_variant` tag.
Carlos (eng): implementation plan: add `campaign_v2` routing rule in onboarding-service. sample grant call below. need idempotency + TTL for bonus credits (48h).
```
POST /campaigns/grant
{
  "user_id": "<uid>",
  "campaign_id": "starter_webinar_apr",
  "variant": "webinar_bonus",
  "grant": [{"amount":75, "reason":"starter_flow"}, {"amount":50, "reason":"webinar_bonus", "expires_at":"48h"}],
  "conditions": ["tokens_first_7d>=100", "template_walkthrough.completed==true", "webinar.attended==true"]
}
```
Carlos (eng): note: backend will validate `webinar.attended` via event sync from webinar-provider. we should also add fraud checks (same ip/email patterns) to avoid abuse.
Hannah (support): heads up: prior credit campaigns led to chargebacks and support questions about expiration. propose we add clear modal copy and an FAQ blurb. Also set alert if support mentions spike >2x.
LegalBot: Promo terms reminder: credits are non-transferable, expire per campaign settings; do not promise SLA or refunds. include link to legal template: https://notion.redwood/legal/promo-terms
Owen (demand-gen): copy lines for blog/webinar landing: "Join our workshop & get 125 free credits to build a working demo" vs "Try our curated starters + webinar to cut prompt time"  which should we test?
Nina (growth): test both headlines in the landing page: one product-first, one outcome-first. variant mapping: landing_A + base_credit, landing_B + webinar_bonus. sample size plan: power to detect 5% lift -> need ~1.5k eligible users per arm; we'll soft launch at 5% sampling to validate instrumentation.
Priya (analytics): I'll add dashboards: landing -> registration -> walkthrough started -> walkthrough completed -> credits granted -> active trial -> paid. include funnel conversion and cost per converted trial (credits used). I'll also add cohort by `referral_channel` and `utm_campaign`.
Carlos (eng): ETA: 2 days for grant endpoint updates + webhook to webinar provider, 3 days for campaign flagging in onboarding UI, 2 days for modal copy integration. Can parallelize.
Hannah (support): Can we include pre-written responses for common Qs: "why didn't I get the webinar bonus?" and "when do credits expire"? I'll draft.
notion-bot: Notion page created: /Marketing/experiments/starter-webinar-credit-run (owner: Nina)
Nina (growth): action items: Owen - landing + webinar promo, Priya - dashboards + event spec, Carlos - grant + event wiring, Hannah - support docs, Legal - approve promo copy by EOD.
LegalBot: approved subject to adding expiration text on landing and an abuse clause.
Owen (demand-gen): promo budget: budgeted 150k credits + $2.5k ad spend for acquisition test.
Priya (analytics): add rollback triggers: cost-per-conversion > $150 or support tickets >2x baseline. also stop if fraudulent pattern metric >0.5% users.
Nina (growth): timeline: start sampling 5% on Monday, monitor for 3 days, then ramp to 20% if stable. sync Thursday for interim signal.
Carlos (eng): I'll open PRs today and link them here once ready.
Nina (growth): thanks all  looking for a clean benchmark and a launch blog tying webinar outcomes to the product narrative. if we get + lift we'll use bench numbers in the launch post.
Hannah (support): ping me when modal copy is live so I can train frontline.
Priya (analytics): ping once events are live, I'll validate and run a quick lift analysis after 72h.
notion-bot: Experiment doc updated with event spec and dashboard links.
